pitch.headline: Traditional, static courses do not work
pitch.body: Traditional courses don't work. The team finishes them, forgets everything, and reverts to old habits. AITutoro provides 5-minute sessions tailored to a busy workday. Each employee receives a path based on their role, level, and the work they do. The result: people who actually use AI — not just "finished the course."

pitch2.headline: 5 minutes. Skills that last.
pitch2.body:
Closing the AI skills gap does not require marathon training sessions or taking people off work.

With AITutoro, employees learn through short modules that fit into each working day. Each lesson relates directly to their role - tailored to the organization's goals and personalized for each person's skill level.

You will see exactly who is making progress and where the organization needs more support. Not just training — measurable growth in skills.
